description.fun: Mareep's fluffy wool builds up static as it rubs together, swelling as it charges, so petting one can give you a shock. It sheds the fleece every summer and regrows it in a week, and farms make it into fine clothing that needs special treatment so it doesn't crackle. Its name blends 'Mary had a little lamb' with sheep, and is an anagram of ampere.
description.guide: A sheep-like Electric-type Pokémon whose wool builds up static electricity, with a tail bulb that glows as it charges. It is often kept on farms, where its wool is made into clothing. It evolves into Flaaffy and then Ampharos.
description.tagline: A sheep whose wool stores static electricity

description.fun: Flaaffy stored so much electricity that most of its wool fell out, leaving bare, rubbery skin that protects it from its own charge. What wool it has left makes more electricity from less fleece, and it fights by firing electrified hairs at opponents. The blue orb on its tail lights up when its mane is fully charged.
description.guide: A pink, two-legged sheep Pokémon of the Electric type, evolved from Mareep. Storing too much electricity has left it with bare, rubbery skin and a woolly mane that charges efficiently. It evolves into Ampharos.
description.tagline: Lost its wool to its own electricity, and doesn't mind

description.fun: The orb on Ampharos's tail shines so brightly that it can be seen from space, and people have long used it as a beacon to signal across the sea. Its name mixes 'amp' with pharos, an old word for lighthouse. Mega Evolution awakens long-dormant dragon blood, regrowing a flowing mane of wool and making it Electric and Dragon.
description.guide: The final form of Mareep, a yellow Electric-type Pokémon that has shed all its wool. The bright orb on its tail has been used as a beacon to signal across the ocean. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Ampharos, which gains the Dragon type.
description.tagline: A living lighthouse whose tail can be seen from space

description.fun: Mega Evolution stirs its genes, regrowing white wool on its head and tail and awakening long-dormant dragon blood, which makes it Electric and Dragon. Red orbs dotted through its wool blaze with light as it charges.
